sql: select t.exercise_id, t.level, e.exercise_type_id, e.concept_id, et.title->>'en' as topic, el.id as loc_id, el.full_sentence from translation_selected_exercises t join exercises e on e.id = t.exercise_id join exercise_types et on et.id = e.exercise_type_id left join exercise_localizations el on el.exercise_id = t.exercise_id and el.language_code = 'de' order by t.exercise_id
